title: Mood induction in MDD and healthy adolescents
description: MEG and structural MRI recordings from adolescents with major depressive disorder and healthy controls, collected for a pre-registered study of electrophysiological correlates of mood and reward dynamics. It includes a monetary gambling mood induction task (task-mmi3), pre-processed with bad channels and segments marked, and a 10-minute unprocessed resting-state scan from the same session. Anatomical MRIs are defaced and include co-registered fiducial coordinates.
methods_description: MEG was acquired during a monetary gambling mood induction task and a 10-minute resting-state scan in the same session. Task data were pre-processed by marking bad channels and bad segments (motion >5 mm or noise artifacts). Structural MRIs were defaced and fiducial coordinates co-registered.

funding_references.funder_name: National Institute of Mental Health, Intramural Research Program
